newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX electricity ends mixed though little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX electricity ends mixed though little changed.

text.p: NYMEX electricity futures ended mixed though little changed Tuesday with much of the complex resisting fundamental weakness from expectations of large hydroelectric generation in the West, sources said.
"The fundamental psychology of the market should be downward as far as the expectations for hydroelectric generation go," said one Houston-based futures trader.
March California Oregon Border (COB) settled down 30 cents at $10.30 per megawatt hour (MWh) after trade in a range of $10.25-10.40 per MWh.
